name: shipgate
description: CLI that stages, scans, commits, and pushes coding-agent changes under a local policy, plus a browser policy simulator.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @shipgate/core && npm run build -w @shipgate/cli && npm run build -w @shipgate/web
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test -w @shipgate/core && npm run test -w @shipgate/cli && npm run test -w @shipgate/web
